▌❯ Why does the cache miss after a resize?

◌ Thought · 2 lines
┃ The key holds the width.
┃ A resize changes it.

● The cache is keyed by width.
  ⋯ 4 more lines

◆ Bash  grep -n width cache.go
  └ cache.go:10: key := width + 0
    cache.go:11: key := width + 1
    ⋯ +8 lines · ctrl+e
    cache.go:20: key := width + 10
    cache.go:21: key := width + 11
    cache.go:99: // the stale entry is dropped here

● Keying by width is intended.
